summary: @servicetitan/eh-module-communication preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB Bun-compiled JS bundle at the tarball root that begins with a shuffled-string-array rotator (WV8StW) and a numeric lookup table, and uses hex-named identifiers and proxy-call indirection consistent with obfuscator.io output. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with the same identifier and proxy-call pattern. package.json declares only ["dist","src"] in its files manifest, so math_init.js is undeclared even though it is the file the lifecycle hook actually executes. The package advertises itself as a shared communication registry between web modules, which has no relationship to installing an alternate JavaScript runtime and running an obfuscated bundle at install time. Invocation under a freshly-downloaded Bun binary evades Node-oriented static analyzers, so the actual behavior of the executed payload is not observable without running it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
